stepTitle: A sine function crosses the y-axis at $$y=\frac{1}{2}$$. Its maximum value is $$2$$, and its minimum value is $$-1$$. It attains its maximum at $$x=\frac{\pi}{8}$$ and its minimum at $$x=\frac{-\pi}{8}$$. \n The function shown is of the form $$y=A\sin(Bx)+D.$$ Identify the amplitude $$A.$$

figureAlts.figure2.gif: A sine function that crosses the y-axis through the point y equals one half, reaches its maximum value of y equals 2 at x equals pi over 8, and reaches its minimum value of y equals negative 1 when x equals negative pi over 8
